## Training data

**Regenerated rows.** 250,000 conversations of the Datakit SFT mixture (the data the 09.21 model was fine-tuned on), whose assistant turns were regenerated by [`open-athena/Grug-67B-A2B-Datakit-SFT-262K-2026.09.21-dr-doom`](https://huggingface.co/open-athena/Grug-67B-A2B-Datakit-SFT-262K-2026.09.21-dr-doom) itself, at T=1, top-p 1, at most 32,768 new tokens per turn within the row's 32,768-token window. The drafter trained on the regenerated text (loss on the regenerated assistant tokens only).

- **Which conversations.** Drawn uniformly without replacement (seed 0) from the Datakit rows of steps 80,813 to 160,860 of the itw run's batch order: 1,351,917 rows, **none of which the first 80,813 steps (the warm-start checkpoint's training) saw**.
- **Regeneration statistics.** 1,542,021,062 generated tokens, 6,168 per row on average (about 1.4x the 4,413 per row the 09.21 model produced on these conversations), 10.2% of the rows reached the 32,768-token limit, 0 request errors; 10 h 37 min on 2 GB200 nodes including server start-up (about 20.6k generated tokens/s per node). The merged dataset is 2,375,840,544 tokens; 0.5% of the rows were held out for validation.
- **Draft vocabulary.** The 32,000-token draft vocabulary is the warm-start checkpoint's own (a fine-tune must keep it: the drafter's output head and learned weights are indexed by draft token). It covers 98.35% of the regenerated supervised tokens (the best possible 32,000 tokens for this text would cover 98.44%; the vocabulary built from this text would differ from the kept one in 1,995 tokens).

[`regen_stats.json`](regen_stats.json) holds these numbers and [`regen_rows.npy`](regen_rows.npy) the 250,000 sampled row indices in draw order (rows of the Datakit dataset described by the [itw run's data manifest](https://huggingface.co/atutej/dspark_grug-67b-a2b-datakit-sft-dr-doom_datakit-sft-mix_itw-160k-20261020/blob/main/training_data_manifest.json), in shard order; recomputed from the batch order and the seed, and checked to equal the regenerated rows).
